scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and explicit construction; rational finite checks are diagnostic only; no external independent audit or claimed certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the zero-constant contractive multiplier class and the Drury–Arveson norm are covered. Equality classifies coefficient moduli but not phases. Older equivalent priority, especially 2002 multivariable Bohr literature, is not exhaustively resolved.
title: Sharp anchored Bohr sets and coefficient-modulus rigidity for Drury–Arveson multipliers
